newsitem.title: FRANCE: ANA increases ex-Paris air cargo rates.
newsitem.headline: ANA increases ex-Paris air cargo rates.

text.p: PARIS, Jan 6 (Reuter) All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA), said it had increased its ex-Paris cargo rates by 50 centimes/kilo, effective January 1.
ANA operates daily Boeing 747 passenger services between Paris-CDG and Tokyo's Narita airport.
"The increases work at around three percent on the average per kilo rate on the Paris-Tokyo route," an ANA cargo official told Reuters.
ANA introduced similar rates increases in April 1996.

"In Autumn 1996, our rates remained unchanged, having previoulsy increased, on a regular basis, every six months, nor did we apply a fuel surcharge. These factors gave us scope to increase rates early in 1997 on a route where demand is very buoyant at present," the ANA official said.
In October 1996, ANA was appointed French cargo sales agent for Japanese cargo airline (NCA).
ANA organises trucking services from France carrying feeder traffic to NCA's 747F flights between Amsterdam and Tokyo. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
